# Historical scene execution audit

**Citation provenance.** All citations identify the supplied expanded files and exact lines. For compactness, define the common project root as `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender`. For the laboratory case, `L` is `outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/external_followup/scene_rsi_pilot/selected/external_followup/bw_0011/`; its archive is `work/scene_archive/bundles/external_followup--scene_rsi_pilot.tar.gz`, with member prefix `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/external_followup/scene_rsi_pilot/selected/external_followup/bw_0011/`. For the chaise case, `C` is `outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/fixed_h0/H0/development/commons_109923183/`; its archive is `work/scene_archive/bundles/r1--fixed_h0.tar.gz`, with member prefix `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/fixed_h0/H0/development/commons_109923183/`. Each citation’s suffix applies to both its expanded-file and archive-member prefixes.

## Laboratory: bw_0011

**Code and intent.** The selected step constructs a room from independently owned architecture, cabinet, mural, display, ceiling and services. Boxes form walls, seams and a seven-strip cove; the cabinet has two framed glass doors and shelves. Seeded rods and balls form botanical imagery; segmented boxes form the display; grid, tiles, diffusers, beams and rods form the overhead assembly [X0404, `L/steps/002/build.py`, lines 48–124, 126–190]. The nominal wall height is 3.2; absolute scale is explicitly uncertain. These coordinates and ownership claims do **not** establish physical contact or image fidelity [X0404, lines 20–36, 192–202].

The code copies scoped mesh data and materials, applies metallic and transmission settings to cabinet colors, and uses noise through a color ramp for the mural backing—not a reference-image texture [X0404, lines 204–258]. Camera position is (−1.15, −6.8, 1.83), target (−0.62, 2.8, 1.78), lens 32. The revision lowers world strength to 0.12, LED power to 65 and entrance power to 135, with camera-ray-only white background and diffuser emission 1.5 [X0404, lines 31–38, 260–297]. Step 1 used world strength 0.65, LED power 180, entrance power 450 and diffuser emission 2.5 [X0402, `L/steps/001/build.py`, lines 263–290].

**Execution and quality.** Both executions report success, empty stderr, finished 16-sample renders and saved PNG and blend files in Blender 4.2.10; the logged render times were 6.20 and 6.25 seconds [X0403, `L/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X0405, `L/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7]. The task specifies a 512 × 293 reference, not independently measured output dimensions [X0406, `L/task.json`, lines 2–5]. The step-2 author described step 1 as too pale and estimated shifted cabinet and mural bounds and a ceiling-slope mismatch; these are visual estimates, not calibrated measurements, and the geometry was not revised [X0404, lines 6–17]. No images are supplied here for independent visual assessment.

Selection records step 2, although `record.json` has `selected: null` [X0400, `L/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0399, `L/record.json`, lines 53–57]. The record reports validity and overall 0.4876, SSIM 0.3338 and LPIPS 0.6514; functional checks pass but explicitly assess structural/edit operability, while semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null [X0399, lines 16–34]. A subsequent student call timed out after approximately 600 seconds despite the complete status and two successful renders; this was an LLM-call timeout, not evidence of a Blender rendering failure [X0399, lines 39–53].

## Chaise: commons_109923183

**Code and intent.** The recorded step-3 code builds a painted and gilt chaise with swept rails, legs and floral relief, plus paneled walls, parquet and a partial cane chair [X0415, `C/steps/003/build.py`, lines 10–28, 30–67, 69–145]. After realization it creates separate mesh upholstery, headboard, side wings and pillow, plus curve-based stripes and rose marks. Fabric and pillow use procedural noise-to-bump nodes [X0415, lines 147–170, 201–215, 230–249, 251–303, 305–332]. Their intended placement is not proof of support or contact.

Camera is (2.65, −4.65, 3.30), target (−0.05, 0.02, 1), lens 51; two area lights and a 0.24-strength world are specified. The script requests Cycles, 48 samples, denoising, 512 × 384, AgX and exposure 0.15; these are code settings, not independently observed final render metadata [X0415, lines 351–374].

**Execution and acceptance.** Step 1 failed before rendering because a 0.13 fillet exceeded half the 0.13-thick seat’s smallest dimension [X0412, `C/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7]. Step 2 reduced that radius to 0.06 but failed when the world was `None` [X0413, `C/steps/002/build.py`, lines 56–57; X0414, `C/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7]. Step 3 adds a world-creation guard [X0415, lines 357–365]. Selection records step 3, and the aggregate record reports complete, valid, three executions and no runtime error; no step-3 result log is supplied, so its individual render completion cannot be independently confirmed from that log [X0409, `C/selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0408, `C/record.json`, lines 16–23, 39–53].

The aggregate overall score is 0.3907, SSIM 0.2250 and LPIPS 0.8505. Functional passes concern edit operability of target `arm gold-1`, not verified whole-object completeness or collision truth, both null [X0408, lines 17–34]. Neither numerical acceptance nor a completed run independently establishes visual quality; the supplied text permits no image-based judgment.
